findings.title: progress visibility rule conflicts between onProgressChanged and the gating section for a mid-load gate flip
findings.location: design.md §3 onProgressChanged vs. Parked/policy gating and AC6
findings.fix: State that stale-progress hiding on a mid-load gate change is owned by enforcePolicy() (invoked from parkingListener); onProgressChanged's allowed() guard only prevents a new progress tick from re-showing the bar. Add that clarifying line to §3.

findings.title: urlField is never populated before the first page load; initial display state unspecified (renders blank on launch)
findings.location: design.md §1 View / §1 Keeping the field in sync / onCreate ordering
findings.fix: Call syncAddress() once at the end of buildLayout() (or right after setContentView in onCreate) so the field shows currentUrl() (HOME on cold start) from first paint instead of empty text.

findings.title: AC2 and §3 onReceivedTitle disagree on title-vs-URL precedence wording
findings.fix: Reword AC2 to: text equals the current URL when one exists; when the WebView has no URL yet, the title may be shown as a transient label.

findings.title: urlField focus semantics unspecified given host-owned input
findings.fix: Add that focus is for D-pad/rotary traversal only and the control responds solely to click; the host owns the IME (CarUiController takes com.google.android.gms.car.input.InputManager) so no phone IME attaches to the TextView.

findings.title: "loads it verbatim" overstates ContentAddress.https for full https URLs
findings.fix: Reword to: loads it as the normalized https URL (ContentAddress.https toASCIIString() output), which is byte-identical for already-canonical URLs.
